title: Bernie Madoff's Confession: The Paper Trail, the Warnings and the 150-Year Sentence
summary: December 2008: Bernard Madoff tells two senior employees his investment business is "all just one big lie." Built from the U.S. Attorney's own releases, his plea statement and the SEC inspector general's report, this is how the scheme worked, the warnings the SEC received, and how Judge Denny Chin arrived at 150 years.
sources: U.S. Attorney S.D.N.Y. — arrest release, Dec 11, 2008
